title: Fourier expansion of noise stability
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$. Then the noise stability of $f$ at correlation $\rho$ is $\displaystyle\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}\rho^{|S|}\widehat f(S)^2$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: The cube has dimension a natural number $n$
The correlation parameter $\rho$ is real and satisfies $-1\leq\rho\leq1$
$f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
